rationale: The agent appears to have authenticated the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details) and accessed an order, but then executed an exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) without any visible user confirmation in the transcript. Policy requires confirming every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the user requested exchanges for both a water bottle and a desk lamp; only one item was exchanged, and there’s no clear evidence it was the correct item (desk lamp) or that product preferences (brighter with AC adapter) and “bigger” for the bottle were validated. There’s also no clear final confirmation of outcomes or costs—only a generic closing. Given missing confirmation and incomplete fulfillment, this does not meet the pass bar.
